description: Users on phones (iOS, Android, cross-platform). Sends its share of the workload over a slower, more variable mobile network, waits longer and retries once by default.
modeled: Open-loop arrivals: clients do not slow down when the system is slow
Per-attempt client timeout and bounded retries with exponential backoff
Its share of the workload, split from the same arrivals as the other client groups
Mobile network delay as the latency of its link (default p50 35 ms / p95 120 ms one way)
notModeled: Offline queues, background sync and app-store release lag
